nft_collections.name: CryptoCore Genesis
nft_collections.description: The founding collection of the CryptoCore universe. 5,000 hand-tuned mining rigs, engineers and reactors powering the Hive economy.
nft_collections.creator: alice

nft_collections.name: Lucky Frogs
nft_collections.description: 3,000 amphibious optimists hopping across the Hive chain. Each frog carries its own luck rating and swamp lineage.
nft_collections.creator: bob

nft_collections.name: Pixel Warriors
nft_collections.description: A 4,000 piece pixel-art battle roster. Warriors are generated from 120 traits across weapons, armor and battle scars.
nft_collections.creator: charlie

nft_collections.name: Hive Legends
nft_collections.description: Portraits of the Hive ecosystem's most storied characters, rendered as collectible on-chain cards.
nft_collections.creator: alice

nft_collections.name: Cyber Hive
nft_collections.description: Neon drone swarms and synthetic hives. A cyber-industrial series with animated rarity tiers.
nft_collections.creator: david

nft_collections.name: Genesis Beasts
nft_collections.description: Mythical creatures forged in the first block. Genesis Beasts unlock in-game utility across partner Hive games.
nft_collections.creator: eve

nft_collections.name: Solar Nomads
nft_collections.description: Wanderers of the solar belt. A quiet, painterly collection focused on landscape and light.
nft_collections.creator: charlie

nft_collections.name: Block Botanica
nft_collections.description: Generative flora grown from block hashes. Every plant is a snapshot of the chain at mint time.
nft_collections.creator: bob
